meaningKo: 새로운 시작을 하다, 과거를 잊고 앞으로 나아가다
exampleEn: It's time to turn the page and focus on the future.
exampleKo: 이제 새로운 시작을 하고 미래에 집중할 시간이에요.
gameExamples: After years of struggle, I finally decided to turn the page and embrace a new chapter in my life.
She realized it was time to turn the page and leave her past behind for good.
To move forward, we must turn the page and stop dwelling on our mistakes.
